hints.title: Sorted Window Boundary Invariant
hints.text: Because arr is sorted, the k closest elements always form a contiguous subarray window of size k.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Shrinking Strategy
hints.text: Initialize left at 0 and right at len(arr) - 1. While the window size exceeds k, compare the distance of arr[left] and arr[right] to x.

hints.title: Outermost Extremum Discard Rule
hints.text: If x - arr[left] > arr[right] - x, increment left to drop the further left element; otherwise decrement right to drop the right element.

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N - K) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full array sorting with distance comparator takes O(N log N) time and ignores the existing sorted order.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual-pointer window shrinking eliminates N - K elements directly in O(N - K) operations with zero allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should preserve tie-break rules preferring smaller numerical values when distances are equal.
